blockedIdentities.reason: IBS is shared by multiple unrelated active industrial manufacturers, including fluid-control, cooling-system and power-system businesses. The repository record has no country, legal-name or product-scope discriminator that safely selects one manufacturer-owned source.

The manufacturer-owned KRANZ-Packungen Kuhrmeier site currently exposes only a maintenance placeholder with legal identity and contact details. It does not provide a substantive About or Products source sufficient to verify product scope for BRAND_SAFE.
ARTTECH is used by multiple unrelated businesses and no manufacturer-owned domain with matching industrial product identity could be tied to this unsuffixed repository record without guessing.
CAB is a short generic identity used by unrelated companies. The repository record has no country, legal-name or product-family discriminator that would safely establish one canonical manufacturer.

The FIBRO identity now spans FIBRO GmbH standard parts and the independently operated FIBRO Rundtische GmbH rotary-table business. The unsuffixed repository record does not distinguish these current entities, so a combined profile would be misleading.

Hibar Systems was acquired and renamed Tesla Toronto Automation, while HIBAR pump technology is now manufactured under a licensing arrangement by Unicontrols. A current manufacturer-owned or official parent brand page establishing the public Hibar entity was not available, so the legacy record remains blocked.

Konrad Reitz Ventilatoren GmbH & Co. KG is already represented by the curated canonical manufacturerId reitz. Creating another SAFE profile would publish duplicate manufacturer pages; this record requires canonical merge or alias resolution.
